notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
[b]CUSTOM KEY BINDING AVAILABLE FOR KEYBOARD[/b]

[list]
[*] Added functionality that allows for keyboard plays to rebind controls!
[/list]

This was feedback given to us from many keyboard players. We're sorry it took us a while to get to it, but it is in the game now! Controller players may not rebind as we did not receive any complaints about controller binds.

Happy Merchanting!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed bug where other special powers were also pausing time, and sometimes the round would be paused forever
- Fixed bug where player could exit the work space in level 3-1

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
- Controls screen would not disappear after player exited the pause menu.

Visual Fixes:
- Changed upgrade and purchase bars to fit the theme
- Made it so the upgrade bar only appears if the counter has an upgrade to begin with

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
- Customers would not come in level 5-3
- Counters wouldn't reset for interns on level restarts

Quality of Life:
- Interns can now combine items

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Visual Fixes:
- Added a new progress bar
- Added level names

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
- Sale Counter not restarting after a level ended or was reset
- Customers not coming anymore and round timer not starting eventually leading the game to crash
- The "wood and plank" item and the "staff" were not being synchronized to all clients

Visual Fixes:
- Control screen was not being properly scaled to some screen sizes
- Planning panels would sometimes show on playing mode
- Settings menu in game would have "squashed" buttons

Quality of Life:
- Improved overall scoring balance for all levels
- Increased customer time in queue and waiting to order
- Only show "View Counter Info" key bind if the player is facing a counter

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 - Cont'd
notes.content:
Bugs:
- FIXED: Further issue with automated counter SFX

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
During the first 24h of the game, a couple of small bugs were reported that have now been fixed!

Bugs:
- FIXED: SFX for automatic counters would not stop playing even after player was done using them.
- FIXED: Player could start level without mandatory counters if some other panels (catalog, inventory, etc) were open.

Quality of Life:
- ADDED: Small animations for the buttons in the book to more easily catch players' eyes to page turning.
